_comment_nas_shared: KB-on-NAS deployment, client side. stdio + the local mount point of the shared KB. The kb_path arg here is redundant with kb-mcp.toml; either keep both (explicit beats config) or drop the args and rely on the toml. Mount the share so its PARENT is on local disk — .kb-mcp.db is created next to kb_path and must stay off the network filesystem. See README.md / README.ja.md.
_comment_alwaysLoad: alwaysLoad: true is a Claude Code v2.1.121+ option that ensures kb-mcp's tools are present at initial load (skips tool-search lookup latency). Other MCP clients (Cursor, etc.) ignore the field. Drop it if first-startup model download cost outweighs the latency win.
